title: 最優秀クラシックウマ娘選出！

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: <username>! I have amazing news to share!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: You see, I'm on the panel of selectors for the Best Umamusume Awards, and—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I just heard some great news from the URA. You might have received an email already, but I thought I'd tell you in person anyway.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: …Oh, but I see you have a visitor. I apologize for barging in.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I think we may be here about the same thing!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case, take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open up the letter she hands me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Dear <chrname>, we are pleased to inform you that you have been selected as this year's Best Classic Year Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Yes. The award goes to the Umamusume deemed to have had the best overall performance throughout the year.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: This is not an award that just anyone can hope to win. In other words…

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You did superb. That about sums it up. As a fellow member of this academy, I am proud.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I wish to congratulate you as well!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: That said, the Twinkle Series is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Stay focused, and keep up this momentum going into senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, <chrname> and I vow to keep working hard next year, too.
